instructions.question: What overall feeling does the tweet's author show toward its topic: positive, neutral, or negative?
instructions.rule: Positive includes mild warmth or upbeat tone: looking forward to plans, cheerful invitations ('come see me!!', 'see you there!'), good-luck wishes, holiday fun, tributes, and news of wins, records, releases, tours or new products. Neutral is dry information, bare logistics or listings, questions, speculation, and calm sports or political analysis. Negative needs explicit annoyance, sadness, insults or personal setbacks (#fml, crying, :/), critical jabs, or news of harm or trouble such as deaths, attacks, charges, scandals or war. Mock-dramatic fandom posts and joking stress stay neutral.

neutral.what: Factual updates, bare logistics, questions, predictions, opinions without emotional words, and joking exaggeration.
examples: Special Labor Day COOL OUT goes down TOMORROW NIGHT @ the Gin Mill 10-2
Pochettino should have started Alli. He'll probably do a Kane and keep him on the bench till November. Might be too late for him this term
date: august 11th still no sign of frank ocean's new album. the world is turning on itself. buildings are burning. god refuses to comment.
neutral.cues: tomorrow night, tickets, specials, ?, should have, may, probably, lol
neutral.not_for: Plans or promos with clear enthusiasm (positive); real complaints, setbacks, or harmful news (negative).

positive.what: Any warmth, anticipation, praise, well-wishing or tribute, upbeat promotion, or good news such as wins, releases and launches.
examples: It’s Tuesday night in Athens! AKA karaoke night at the Volstead so come see me!!
Guess who's going to see Foo Fighters on Tuesday!!!!! (ME)
New iPhones, iPad Pro, and Apple TV on the way today at 10 A.M. (PDT)! #AppleEvent
Happy Birthday Wilt Chamberlain may you rest in peace
positive.cues: see you, come see, good luck, can't wait, love, best, awesome, happy, tribute, new album, wins, :)
positive.not_for: Dry schedules, ads or ticket listings with no upbeat tone (neutral); 'can't wait' used sarcastically (negative).

negative.what: Anger, sadness, insults, personal disappointment or inconvenience, critical jabs, and news of harm, scandal or trouble.
examples: Just remembered I'm taking the PSSAs tomorrow. #Fml
Caitlyn Jenner May Face Manslaughter Charge in Malibu Crash I read it on @user #video:
@user so the thing next Thursday isn't free, you'd have to pay $15 to get in since you don't go to UMBC :/ and it ends at 11:30"
negative.cues: sucks, wtf, #fml, crying, pity, nervous, ugh, :/, :(, killed, charge, problems, delayed, war
negative.not_for: Calm analysis, hedged speculation, playful exaggeration, or RIP tributes praising someone (neutral or positive).
